meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 它会把一个文件夹、网址、粘贴的笔记或刚才的对话整理成一份可复用的技能文件，保存在 .claude/skills/ 下；如果该技能已存在，就读取后更新它，而不是另建新的。
howto.when: 当你说出『/learn』、『turn this into a skill』、『capture this workflow』等，或要求把文件夹、网址、笔记、刚才的对话变成技能，以及更新某个已有技能时触发。

say.note: 它会读取文件夹结构，生成一份操作该项目的技能文件。

say.text: 把刚才我们一步步做的事变成技能
say.note: 它会回看对话，提炼出可重复的步骤。

say.text: 更新一下 wow-on-steam-deck 这个技能
say.note: 它会先读现有技能，再把新经验合进去。

howto.what_en: It turns a source — a folder, a URL, pasted notes, or the conversation so far — into a reusable skill file saved under .claude/skills/; if that skill already exists, it reads and updates it instead of creating a new one.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says '/learn', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', etc., asks to turn a folder/URL/notes/recent work into a skill, or asks to improve/update an existing skill.

say_en.note: It reads the structure and writes a skill file for working with it.

say_en.text: Turn what we just did step by step into a skill
say_en.note: It reviews the conversation and distills the repeatable steps.
It reads the current skill first, then merges in new learnings.
